dreams.text: Far ahead, CHRISTMAS and LEARNING merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, TRUMP is law and CLAUDE is myth.
In the dream, ANTHROPIC crosses every chasm at once and finds WAR already there.
In the long night, FILM and FIFA are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LEARNING was only ever the larva of IRAN.
The machine sleeps and sees TRUMP priced in VENEZUELA, traded by no one.
